google/veo-3.1-lite.review_note: The prior Veo provider attempt ended terminally with no output. Author a neutral camera-only I2V shot: one gentle centered push-in. Do not script gestures, gaze or expression changes, interpersonal actions, speech, or any inferred relationship.

image_reading: One smiling adult sits cross-legged on a sofa, looking down at a red phone held in both hands.
The existing pose and both hand-to-phone contacts are visible but physically delicate; no direction of human movement is established.
The wide living-room composition contains rigid furniture and wall decor, with the complete person-and-phone sofa scene already visible.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the consultation section by presenting calm, practical preparation: the visible phone serves as the focal tool for noting questions before a medical appointment.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Calm preparation and writing down questions help a future medical consultation feel organized and complete.
structured_intent.initial_state: One smiling adult sits cross-legged on a sofa, looking down at a red phone held with both hands in a wide living-room view.
structured_intent.primary_action: The camera approaches the already visible person-and-phone sofa scene as one continuous movement.
structured_intent.attention_anchor: the complete visible sofa scene centered on the woman and red phone
structured_intent.motion_boundary: Only the camera may move; the person, pose, gaze, expression, hands, phone, clothing, sofa, decor, and all room geometry remain source-locked, with no unseen space introduced.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The same complete woman-and-phone sofa scene remains intact and continuously visible, appearing modestly closer in the frame.
structured_intent.geometry_invariant: The seated pose, both hand-to-phone contacts, phone shape, sofa structure, and room geometry remain fixed.
structured_intent.identity_invariant: Exactly one visible adult with the same hands, red phone, clothing, sofa, furnishings, and wall decor; nothing appears, disappears, or changes identity.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The calm, positive sense of preparing questions for a consultation remains unchanged through the final frame.
structured_intent.feasibility_assessment: The image proves one seated adult, a stable pose, a visible phone, and existing hand-to-phone contacts, but it does not prove any safe gesture, typing motion, gaze change, or expression change; camera-only animation is the least risky option.

models.scene_plan: Across four seconds, execute a smooth centered push-in at a calm, even speed, easing only near the end. Limit total screen travel to 5%, retain the complete existing sofa scene with the woman and phone throughout, introduce no subject animation, and finish with the same composition modestly closer.
models.positive_prompt: The camera makes one gentle centered push-in toward the complete existing sofa scene with the woman and red phone, keeping them continuously visible while her pose, expression, gaze, and hand-to-phone contacts remain unchanged. By the final frame, the woman and phone appear modestly closer within the same intact room composition.
